title: curie example sre-bot provision-observability --json
description: The agent-facing receipt that the Grafana connector token exists. The token value and the Grafana admin password are never included.

secret.description: The Secret the Grafana and Tempo connectors mount.

key.description: The key that must be non-empty. The value is not returned.

namespace.description: The Curie release namespace that holds the Secret.

release.description: The Helm release that was upgraded with the observability values.

observability_namespace.description: The namespace of the Grafana, Loki, Alloy, Prometheus, and Tempo stack.

ready.description: True only when the token key decoded to a non-empty value.
